Volney Town Court

Address:
1445 County Route 6, Fulton, NY 13069, United States
Google Maps Location

Contact Information:

  • Phone: 315-598-7082
  • Fax: 315-598-8713
  • Website: Town of Volney

Working Hours:

  • Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Saturday & Sunday: Closed

Judicial Staff

  • Judges:
    • Judge James A. Aluzzi
    • Judge Patricia Kerifien
    • Judge David Hawthorne
    • Judge James Nicholson
  • Magistrate: N/A
  • Chief Prosecutor: James Nicholson
  • Clerk of Courts: Tina Motyka

Volney Town Court is situated in Oswego County, Fulton, New York, and it is one of 13000 courts of justice in New York. This court is located in the 5th and 4th judicial departments. The Justice court has the power to handle and solve misdemeanor cases. This court has jurisdiction over traffic tickets, criminal, civil, drug peddling, and unauthorized arms possession cases. Wearing a Face mask is compulsory for every visitor to the court. Dropbox is also available in this court.

Division:

Volney Town Court Division consists of two courts:

  • Criminal and Traffic Court
  • Civil and Small Claims Court

How to do a Case Search?

Volney Town Court Case Search can be done online using the first and last name and the city or state. In some confidential cases, information is not available online and in that case, visit the clerk's office for this type of records information.

How to make a payment?

Volney Town Court payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash or with a card at the counter. Service fees of 2.99% are charged if you are using a credit card for payment.

Online

A person can pay online by using the www.paycourtonline.com website. Convenience charges are applied through an online method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check to the court's mailing address. The mailing address is 1445 County Rte 6, Fulton, NY 13069, United States.

see also Hennepin County Court

Civil and Small Claims Court

Volney Town Court civil and small claims court deals with all cases the citizen will not be able to solve on their own. It also hears and solves small claims cases in which claims are up to $3,000. The court hearing is held every Monday at 6:00 pm. Time may also change; you can contact the court for the schedule before your case date.

Criminal and Traffic Court

Volney Town Court criminal and traffic court deals with all types of criminal and traffic cases. In criminal cases, if a person breaks any law or kills someone, the government brings a lawsuit against them. Traffic cases include speeds, accidents, violations, and many more. The court hearing is held every Monday at 4:00 pm. Time may also change; you can contact the court for the schedule before your case date.

see also Courthouse">Clarion County Courthouse

Marriage License

Volney Town Court Marriage License can be obtained from the town clerk. The fee for the license is $10 for each copy. A marriage application must be filled out, sent to the court, or emailed. A birth Certificate, Driver's License or Passport, or Social Security card is required for the license. If a person is divorced, then a divorce document is mandatory. The marriage license is applicable for one year, and a marriage ceremony is held at the court after getting the license. Contact the clerk's office from Monday to Thursday during business hours for any information.

Phone: 315-593-8288

Email: clerk@townofvolney.com

Town Clerk

Volney Town Clerk is responsible for all the application forms, submission, and guidance. The forms and documents it contains are:

  • Application for marriage license and copies of the license application for the copies of birth or death records
  • Form for the service of genealogical

Birth and Death Certificate

Volney Town Court Birth and Death Certificate copy can be obtained from the town clerk. The fee is $10 for each copy for all districts except Monroe County. Monroe County will pay $30 for each copy. Documents required with the form are of two types: Driver's License, photo-ID card, passport and Employment ID or Utility/ telephone bills, and government agency letter dated within the last six months; if you request another relative, then describe the relationship with that person in the form.

Genealogical Service

Volney Town Court provides the genealogical service form. $22 is the fee for getting these services. The information required is a person's marriage, birth, and death records. You had to answer why you needed the data and what the relationship is with that person whose records are requested by you. Print the form and send it to Certification Unit Vital Records Section New York State Department of Health P.O. Box 2602 Albany, NY 12220-2602

see also Maricopa County Superior Court Case Search

District Attorney

Volney Town Court District Attorney's office is in Oswego County, New York. Contact them on their phone number because they do not make court appearances with you. If your case requires an attorney and you hired the district attorney, then mail them or contact them according to the instructions written on their website. The office location is Fulton Municipal Building 141 South First Street, Fulton, New York 13069.

Phone: 315-592-4340

FAQ

What is dropbox?

Dropbox is available at the court's front door for the visitor's convenience. If the court is closed, drop the documents or paper in that box.

Are fees refundable if records are not found in the genealogical service?

No, the fees are not refundable if the requested records are not found.

What is the timing for the Town Clerk's office?

The Town Clerk's office timing is:

Monday: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm

Tuesday to Thursday: 9:00 am to 4:00 pm

What is the dress code for the court?

Volney Town Court's dress code should be attractive and representable. The judge or attorney recommends a business suit or pant coat. Sleeves, short shirts, torn pants, and sandals are not allowed in the court.

What is the service area in the Volney court?

The service area provides case searches, legal documents, dockets, and background checks.

What are the fines for speeding tickets?

Volney Town Court fines for speeding tickets depending on your driving speed limit. Standard ticket fines range between $150 and $300, and the surcharge will be $88 or $90.

What will happen if I do not pay my fine on time?

If you do not pay the fine on time, your driving license will be suspended, and you will also have to pay extra suspension fees.

Do I need to appear in court if I hire an attorney?

If your case is not complicated and you hire an attorney other than the district attorney court, then you need not appear in court.

Can I pay online for my traffic ticket?

Yes, you can pay online using the online website and any payment method.
